entries.title: A long task history no longer fills your disk with writes
entries.body: With thousands of tasks, the app wrote about 30 MB to your computer's disk each time it read your task history, up to hundreds of gigabytes a day. It now reads them without writing anything, in about a third of the time, so the app pauses less.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the app reads the task history without writing a temporary copy of it to disk.
